verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a UI framework could document running builds, tests or rendering headlessly in CI. The pack only covers server-side rendering and supported server runtimes (Node, Deno, Cloudflare Workers). That is a different feature from a documented headless or CI automation workflow, and nothing mentions CI pipelines, headless test running or automation tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
